text: AI Notepad（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：一款轻量通用文本编辑器，在 DSH 主栏提供编辑页面，并加入侧栏入口和设置页。它支持打开、编辑和保存文本文件，提供多标签、查找、撤销重做、编码保留与 Markdown 预览；还可通过 Harness 当前模型改写选区或全文，并先展示差异供确认。适合在 DSH 中查看和修改笔记、文档、配置与代码片段。Windows 上还可使用原生文件选择器和文件关联；AI 功能需要先配置 Harness 默认模型。

AI Notepad adds a text editor to DSH Web. It supports tabs, search, encoding preservation, and Markdown preview. The current Harness model revises selections or whole documents, with diff review before applying changes. Windows file pickers and file associations are included.
想在 DSH 里直接打开和编辑普通文本文件。
有没有办法只让 AI 修改我选中的段落，并先看差异再决定？
我需要在一个编辑器里同时处理多个笔记标签页。
能不能让 DSH 帮我润色或总结整篇文档？
希望 Markdown 文件可以在编辑和预览之间快速切换。
保存文本时怎样保留原来的编码和换行格式？
I want a lightweight text editor inside DSH for notes and config files.
Can I ask the model to revise selected text and review a diff before applying it?

A lightweight, general-purpose, AI-native text editor for DeepSeek Harness.
Plain text editing + selection-scoped AI + Windows file associations.
dsh-ai-notepad README · AI Notepad：AI Notepad is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns the Harness Web UI into a lightweight, general-purpose AI text editor.

dsh-ai-notepad README · Install：From the plugin market after the listing is live. The market entry uses the
version-free GitHub Release tarball, so no npm account is required.

From GitHub:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add JackWangSIA/dsh-ai-notepad
```

A prebuilt tarball is available at:

```text
https://github.com/JackWangSIA/dsh-ai-notepad/releases/latest/download/dsh-ai-notepad.tgz
```

If the package is later published to npm, `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ai-notepad`
will also work.
dsh-ai-notepad README · Install：On DSH Desktop, prefer **Plugins → Add plugin** with the repository URL. The `desktop` profile is managed by the app; do not edit it with the CLI by hand.

dsh-ai-notepad README · What works：- Open, edit, save and Save As any text file through a native Windows picker, or drop a file onto the editor.
- Multi-tab editing with CodeMirror 6, undo/redo, find, line numbers, wrapping, and unsaved-change prompting.
- Encoding-aware I/O: UTF-8, UTF-8 BOM, UTF-16 LE/BE, GB18030/GBK and Windows-1252. Saves preserve the detected encoding, BOM and dominant line ending. GB18030/Windows-1252 round-trip checks refuse lossy writes.
- Binary-file detection protects files from accidental text editing.
- Hash-based compare-before-write: if another program changed the file while it was open, the save returns a conflict and does not write.
- Selection-scoped AI editing: concise, polish, expand, restructure, proofread, or a custom instruction.
- Whole-document AI: polish, concise, summarize, outline and title generation.
- A diff review modal with accept, reject and regenerate. Nothing is written before acceptance. Accepting uses a normal CodeMirror transaction, so Ctrl+Z still works.
- Multiple annotations can be collected and sent in one batch; every reviewed region is validated against the original document before a single undoable edit.

dsh-ai-notepad README · Shortcuts：| Shortcut | Action |
|---|---|
| `Ctrl+S` / `Ctrl+Shift+S` | Save / Save As |
| `Ctrl+Z` / `Ctrl+Y` | Undo / Redo |
| `Ctrl+F` | Find |
| `Ctrl+E` | Toggle Markdown preview / edit |
| `Ctrl+wheel`, `Ctrl+=`, `Ctrl+-`, `Ctrl+0` | Font zoom in / out / reset |
| `Ctrl+Alt+1..4` | Selection concise / polish / expand / proofread |
| `Ctrl+Alt+B` | Add annotation |
| `Ctrl+Alt+N` | Focus AI Notepad from the main shell |

dsh-ai-notepad README · Important Windows limitation：Windows 10/11 protects the default-app choice with a per-user `UserChoice` hash. No third-party application can silently force itself to become the default. AI Notepad therefore registers a real current-user `OpenWithProgids` entry, after which the user chooses it once in Explorer's **Open with → Always use this app**. The plugin can open Windows Default Apps for that choice, but it does not fake the system default. Uninstalling removes the ProgID and Open With entries; if AI Notepad is the current `UserChoice`, it removes that choice so Windows asks again. It cannot restore a previous hash-protected default.

dsh-ai-notepad README · Important Windows limitation：The desktop shell has a single-instance lock but currently ignores file paths in its argv. The VBS launcher is therefore not a simulation: it is the registered file handler, and it delivers paths to the running Harness through the plugin inbox. A second launch focuses the existing window.

dsh-ai-notepad README · Architecture：- `lib/index.js` — Host half. Connection `/api/ai-notepad/*` routes, bounded file I/O, encoding, conflict guards, LLM calls, Windows registry, inbox watcher, pickers, font enumeration.
- `src/` — Client source. `app.jsx` is the full main-column page, `editor.jsx` owns CodeMirror, `store.js` owns tabs/AI/review/settings, `diff.js` and `markdown.js` are pure helpers.
- `lib/client.js` — generated classic ModuleLoader bundle (React and `react/jsx-runtime` stay external).
- `lib/scripts/` — native file pickers, font enumeration and the Windows external-open launcher.
- `scripts/build.mjs` — esbuild bundle step.
- `test/` — Host route/integration tests, encoding tests, VBS→inbox test, store AI/batch tests, ModuleLoader load test, and server-render tests for app/review/preview.

dsh-ai-notepad README · Build and install：```powershell
$node = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe"
$pnpm = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\pnpm\bin\pnpm.mjs"
& $node $pnpm install --ignore-scripts --dir .
& $node scripts/build.mjs

Then install the absolute directory with the Harness `plugin_manager` `install_bundle` action. Do not copy files into the profile manually.

dsh-ai-notepad README · Verification notes：The plugin installs and its Host row is active; the Client registers a main page, a sidebar panel icon and a settings section. Automated tests cover file I/O, encoding, conflict handling, AI request/response shapes with a fake LLM, selection/batch review and apply, generated client load, VBS queue delivery, and server-side rendering of the app, review and preview views. Live behavior was exercised through Windows UI Automation; screenshots in `assets/` come from the running desktop app.
